title: Zelensky stalls on his EU promises to protect gay rights, even as Ukraine rushes through minority-languages law
lede: Zelensky’s government has shown it can move at lightning speed to please EU partners on some minority rights, yet same-sex partnership and hate-crime bills remain stuck in the Ukrainian parliament.
